intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Kaedra finds a bench wide enough for her wings and sits on exactly one half of it.

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “A rare achievement. A bench not designed exclusively for narrow shoulders.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She looks at the empty half. Then at you. Then at the empty half.

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “By royal decree, this half of the bench is available.”

options.labelText: “I accept the terms of the decree.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “Good. I had no plan for enforcing it.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: You sit. Her tail curls out of your way, a little further than it needs to.

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She budges up. There was already room. Now there is a great deal of room, most of it between you.
